build_agent_config: build an AgentConfig TypedDict with model, provider, inputs, and servers for MCP agent setup
create_stdio_server_config: create a StdioServerConfig TypedDict with command, args, env, and cwd for local MCP server
create_http_server_config: create an HTTPServerConfig TypedDict with url, headers, and optional allowed_tools for remote MCP server
create_sse_server_config: create an SSEServerConfig TypedDict with url, headers, and optional allowed_tools for streaming MCP server
create_input_config: create an InputConfig TypedDict with id, description, type, and optional password flag for agent inputs
